banner.title: The Dragon issue-5 opener - the Witchcraft Supplement (folios 4-9), the Anhkheg lore pin (folios 12, 28) and the Wizard Research Rules (folios 24-26, 28)
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 5 (March 1977), the archive.org scan. The Witchcraft Supplement - the anonymous ms. the editor could not attribute, received over fifteen months prior: the witch encounter doctrine (rolls 5 or 7 on the wilderness chart, the 35/65 Lawful/Chaotic split), the 12-sided Order ladder (Low 1-8, High 9-11, Secret 12, one Secret means all Secret), the spell quotas (good 7, Priestess 10 plus one weekly, Low 4 Minor, High 4 Minor and 2 Major, Secret 6 Group A and 3 Group B), the spell matrix ranges and durations, the covens' trade economy (the willingness die, the Table A and B price bands, the 10 gp instructress) and the lair treasure caches by lair type. The Anhkheg - the Featured Creature at folios 12 and 28, its first magazine appearance, pinned lore-against-def: the merged MM1 ankheg def exists, so the print rides the bulette/Remorhaz precedent with its divergences (lair 25 vs 15, enzyme 1-10 vs 1-4, treasure B2 vs C) noted, never silent. The Wizard Research Rules by Charles Preston Goforth, Jr. - the spell research ladder (20 percent at every level, the investment doubling per level), the +1 and serious enchanting costs, the duplication, the ringmaking ladders up to the True Ring, the Wizard Blade with its d8 property roll over the 11-property list, and the Memorial Enchanting In Distress. The voice rides extract/dragon/005/ (all 32 issue pages, the chat-side DjVu OCR transcript); the issue-5 gap report ships pre-flip. The editor's standing caution rides: none of this is official.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. The Witchcraft Supplement and the Wizard Research Rules pin as variant layers with provenance; the Anhkheg rides the lore-against-def precedent against the merged MM1 def - the print divergences (the 25 vs 15 lair percent, the 1-10 vs 1-4 enzyme, the B2 vs C treasure, the 1-6-dice acid squirt vs the def 8-32) noted in the audit, never silent, and no new registry def is created. The witchcraft wilderness encounter table is scoped out on OCR garble per the standing caution - the clean scalars pin, the garbled grid does not; the lair treasure table pins the printed cache bands with the Secret lair unprinted jewelry line as the 0 sentinel and its ring and Secret-item extras in the audit note; the spell matrix pins R and D as printed with 0 the no-printed-duration sentinel; the research ladder pins the doubling investments exactly as printed at all ten levels.

audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-5 OPENER ROUND - three adjudicated chains. The Witchcraft Supplement (folios 4-9, the anonymous ms.): the encounter doctrine (rolls 5 or 7, witches present 50 percent of the time, the 35/65 alignment split), the 12-sided Order ladder (Low 1-8, High 9-11, Secret 12 - one Secret means all Secret), the Secret witch doctrines (75 percent in lair, any terrain, the loner law, no brooms or balls or familiar, the 50 percent sneak, the 13th-level item bar, the cleric-touch instant death, the no-dispel Group B), the spell quotas (good 7, the 4 percent ancient Priestess with ten daily and one weekly at 11th-level saves, Low 4 Minor, High 4 Minor and 2 Major, Secret 6 Group A and 3 Group B), the immunities (witchcraft never affecting Djinn, Efreet or Clerics; the concentration circle; the cleric poison-touch immunity), the trade economy (the willingness die 1-3/4/5-6, Table A 6-15k and Table B 10-50k plus magic items, the 10 gp instructress fee, the 20 percent map cut, the 1-4 alliance die), the witch items (the Skull of Death 5 points per turn and 3 dice undead command, the Luck Charm d20, the Guardian Egg at 250 gp weight and 48-hour reuse with its armor-class-2 Hill Giant 8, Roc 8 and Dragon Turtle 10 dice forms, the Hornet Cape at 36 inches with three 7-inch 3-dice stings, the Seed Satchel 7-12, the Witch Wand 7 spells, the Serpent Belt 10-foot 2-dice, the Love Locket 20 percent and 2 items, the Dart Ring twice per 30 feet, the 40-foot 4-dice Thorn Twine, the 1-3 Hill Seeds), the spell matrix as a 21-row range/duration table with 0 the no-printed-duration sentinel, and the lair treasure as a 4-row cache table by lair type with the Good lair's 1-10 thousand SP and the Secret lair's ring and Secret-item extras riding this note. The Anhkheg (folios 12, 28): the Featured Creature's first magazine appearance, pinned lore-against-def - the merged MM1 ankheg def exists at monsters/monsters/a/ankheg.lua, so this is a provenance pin, never a competing def; the stat block (1-6 appearing, 10-20 feet, armor class 2 over and 4 under, 12/6 move, 3-8 hit dice on the 8-sided die, 25 percent in lair, treasure B2, bite 3-18, the 1-6-dice acid squirt at 30 feet once per six hours, the 1-10 enzyme, the 5-10 foot ambush depth) with every print divergence from the def noted (lair 25 vs 15, enzyme 1-10 vs 1-4, B2 vs C, the acid squirt vs the def 8-32). The Wizard Research Rules (folios 24-26, 28, Goforth): the research ladder as a 10-row table - weeks equal the spell level, the standard investment doubling per level from 2,000 and the certain line from 10,000 at the flat 20 percent success chance - the once-per-stat permanent stat spell, the +1 enchanting at 2 months and 2,000 gp, serious enchanting at 10 months and 10,000 gp, the duplication at 10,000 gp and 10 months times the table number, the ringmaking ladders (serious 10,000 and 10 months; the True Ring at 300,000 xp drained; the Wizard Blade at 200,000 xp with the d8 property roll over the 11-property list and the +6 to -6 named level, the larger 12/16/20-sided dice at 300k/400k/500k), the unlimited ring charges against the 100-charge wands and staffs, the no-reenchanting law, and the Memorial Enchanting In Distress d8 hits. The garbled wilderness encounter grid at folio 4 is scoped out on OCR garble per the standing caution.
